sections.title: ERP AI: how an AI assistant and AI agents work inside your ERP
sections.subtitle: 10 October 2026 · 6 min read ERP AI is now live in Inspire BD IT. It is the result of years of work by our team on AI features and agents, and it changes how people use their ERP: instead of only recording transactions, the ERP can now answer questions, do routine work and warn you before problems happen. This article explains what that means in practice.

sections.title: Why AI belongs inside the ERP

blocks.text: Your ERP already holds the most reliable picture of your business: every sale, purchase, stock movement, payment and payroll run. An AI tool that sits outside the ERP has to be fed exports and copies. ERP AI works where the data already is, with the same users and roles as your ERP, so it can answer from live numbers and hand work to the right person.

sections.title: 1. The AI Assistant: ask instead of searching

blocks.text: Most ERP questions are simple to ask and slow to answer: find the right report, set the filters, export, sort. With the AI Assistant you ask in plain English and get a number, a table or a chart.
“Who are our top 10 customers by outstanding due this month?”

items.text: “Which products sold less this quarter than last quarter?”
“Show stock value by warehouse as a chart.”

blocks.text: Follow-up questions keep the context, so “now only the Dhaka branch” works the way you would expect.

sections.title: 2. AI Agents: from answers to actions

blocks.text: An answer is useful; work done is better.
AI Agents

watch the ERP for moments that need action and prepare the work: a draft purchase order when stock reaches its reorder level, a reminder to a customer whose invoice is overdue, a nudge to a manager whose approval is waiting.

People stay in control. Agents prepare and route; your team reviews and approves important actions in the ERP. The result is less typing, chasing and remembering, and fewer things that slip through the cracks.
Because ERP AI learns from your own history, it can look ahead:
Demand & sales forecasting
predicts sales by product, branch, area and season.
Smart reorder
suggests what to order and warns before stock-outs or expiry.
Cash-flow AI
predicts cash in and out for the coming weeks.
Anomaly & fraud detection
flags duplicate bills, unusual prices and stock mismatches.
Document AI
reads supplier invoices, bills, receipts and delivery challans and prepares the ERP entry for your team to check and post. The original document stays attached for audit.
AI Reports & Insights
turns the numbers into a short daily or weekly briefing: what went up, what went down and what needs attention, with links to the reports behind it.
The quickest wins usually come from one department at a time:
Finance: Document AI for bills, anomaly detection for duplicate payments, and the cash-flow forecast.
Sales: the AI Assistant for daily questions and sales forecasting for planning.
Inventory and purchase: smart reorder with an agent that drafts the purchase orders.
HR: CV screening and attendance insights.
ERP AI works in English. See the full list of capabilities on the ERP AI page .
